items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: It was W. C. Handy's show with J. Rosamond Johnson. And, we played the Alhambra.

ctx.x: We played the [Harlem Opera House] Alhambra Theater and -- and it -- you know whose show it was? It was W. C. Handy's show with J. Rosamond Johnson. And, we played the Alhambra.
